files.description: Four series (4 buildings, 3 resources), 56 daily readings each, shuffled, 7-day horizon.
One series (Library electricity), 35 daily readings, next-day forecast (horizon_days = 1).
Canteen water, 49 days with 3 missing days (never imputed), +05:30 timestamps and one exact duplicate reading (counted once). Expect data_quality_status 'suspect' notes, not a refusal.
Admin Block waste with only 5 days, plus Hostel B water with 3 days: both must return forecast_available = false / insufficient_data with no numbers.

Library electricity, 150 daily readings with weekly pattern and 8% noise: long enough for the optional gradient-boosting model to be backtested against the baseline. Which model wins is decided by the backtest, not by this file.
